svg.title: My GitHub contributions over the last year, drawn as a city by day in front of Helsinki: one tower a week, one window a day. Huginn the raven flies over and poops on each tower, splattering that week's windows in the shade of each day's contributions. 3,079 contributions, longest streak 67 days, busiest Oct 9 (170).
